title: Law to study chatbots' mental health effects
summary: This bill would require the city Health Department to run a public awareness campaign on negative mental health effects of chatbot use, with materials tailored for people under 24, over 60 and veterans. The department would also have to conduct a citywide survey every three years and publish an annual report on chatbot-related mental health emergencies and research. The campaign must launch within 180 days of the law taking effect.
